theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_cylinder_monotonicity
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U) (P : Grassmannian N n) (y : Euclidean N) (ε K : ℝ), W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ball y 1 ⊆ U → 0 < ε → 0 ≤ K → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 → variationMeasure W (closedBall y r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * W.weight (closedBall y r)) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 → (∫⁻ z in closedBall y r ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap z.2 - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ ∂W.measure) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε * r ^ n)) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 → W.weight (closedBall y r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * r ^ n)) → ∀ τ σ ρ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ < 1 → W.weight (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n ≤ W.weight (closedBall y ρ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < 2 * τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n + ENNReal.ofReal (C * (1 + K) * ε * ρ / τ)
